columns.name: PIN
columns.description: Unique PIN identifier for each property

columns.name: Property Address
columns.description: Property street address, not the address of the taxpayer.

columns.name: Most Recent Date Sale
columns.description: Most recent date of sale, where available

columns.name: Most Recent Sale Price
columns.description: Most recent sale price, where available

columns.name: Pure Market Indicator
columns.description: Indicator variable for whether the sale took place as an arms-length sale. Only arms-length sales are considered valid for sales ratio studies. 0 = no, 1 = yes.

columns.name: Estimate (Land)
columns.description: Estimate of the land from Board of Review final figures

columns.name: Estimate (Building)
columns.description: Estimate of the building from Board of Review final figures

columns.name: First Pass Value 1
columns.description: Valuation of the PIN after the first valuation step (Leverage optimal models to predict values)

columns.name: First Pass Value 2
columns.description: Valuation of the PIN after the second valuation step (Adjust values to 10% assessment level)

columns.name: Land Value
columns.description: Value of the land of the PIN

columns.name: Improvement Value
columns.description: Value of any improvements (i.e. buildings) on the land at the PIN

columns.name: First Pass Value 3
columns.description: Valuation of the PIN after the third valuation step (Regressivity adjustment - currently non-functional)

columns.name: First Pass Value 4
columns.description: Valuation of the PIN after the fourth valuation step (Limit excessive ratios)

columns.name: First Pass Value 5
columns.description: Valuation of the PIN after the fifth valuation step (Land valuation)

columns.name: First Pass Value 6
columns.description: Valuation of the PIN after the sixth valuation step (Condominiums)

columns.name: First Pass Value 7
columns.description: Valuation of the PIN after the seventh valuation step (Desktop Review)
